long_biography.plain_text:
Toto Wolff became an owner as well as an executive when he accepted responsibility for Mercedes' motorsport programme and bought into its Formula One team. He had already founded two investment firms, taken a major position in engineering company HWA and joined Williams as a shareholder and director.

His dual position shaped both the sporting and commercial organisation. Mercedes won eight consecutive constructors' championships under Wolff, while the team's growth increased the value of his holding. He remains an executive board director with authority over daily management, allowing the same person to set racing priorities, oversee capital allocation and share directly in the business's results.
